pull.title: rpc: Return the right RPCErrorCode more consistently
pull.body:
Currently, rpc code may return the wrong `RPCErrorCode`. This is perfectly fine, because they should be hit rarely in production.

However, it could be good to be self-consistent. (Otherwise, we could just remove the different error codes and return a single one)

So fix a few error codes:

* An integral out-of-range is now `RPC_TYPE_ERROR`, not `RPC_MISC_ERROR`
* Some invalid args are now `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER`
* Some transient issues or user-config issues are now `RPC_MISC_ERROR`

tACK faf54f9c1b

Tested on macOS 27.2 arm64 (release build) against master `c68583ab5a`. The PR's `rpc_net.py` fails on master with `Unexpected JSONRPC error code -1` and passes with this PR.

| Case | Calls tested | Master | PR |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Integer out of range | `getblockhash 99999999999999999999`, `getblockhash -99999999999999999999`, `listtransactions "*" -1`, `addpeeraddress 1.2.3.4 65536` | -1 | **-3** |
| Invalid argument | `addnode 127.0.0.1:1 abc`, `setban 1.2.3.4 abc`, `mockscheduler 0` | -1 | **-8** |
| Simulated internal bug | `-named echo arg9=trigger_internal_bug` | -1 | **-32603** |
| Fee estimation disabled (`-blocksonly`) | `estimatesmartfee 2`, `estimaterawfee 2` | -32603 | **-1** |
| Missing argument | `getblockhash` | -1 | -1 |
| Height out of range | `getblockhash 1000` | -8 | -8 |
| Invalid block hash | `getblock abc` | -8 | -8 |
| Unknown method | Nonexistent RPC method | -32601 | -32601 |
| Help | `help getblockhash` | OK | OK |

Error messages were identical before and after in all tested error cases; only the codes changed where shown. The node remained running after the simulated internal bug in this release build.
